subject: Elara Health - access controls alignment & service-account plan
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@elarahealth.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com
Cc: it@elarahealth.com
Date: 2027-03-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Access controls for Redwood rollout - initial ask

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team is excited to move toward a production pilot. Before we lock dates, two quick asks so we can align internal stakeholders: 

1) SSO/SAML: we need Redwood's preferred cutover pattern (metadata exchange, SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated recommendation) and a target 2-hour maintenance window for final cutover.
2) SCIM: we need attribute mappings for group sync and a sample provisioning account with least privilege requirements.
3) Network: Elara runs a strict IP allowlist. Who owns the IP ranges you need us to whitelist (we'll need CIDR ranges and contact for egress validation).
4) Service accounts & org policies: list of service accounts Redwood will create/require and any org-level policies that might affect provisioning (e.g., group naming conventions, role attributes).

I've looped in our IT mailbox (it@elarahealth.com) — we can turn around metadata quickly once we know the exact fields you expect. Also attaching our internal org policy doc for context.

Can you propose a short timeline and who from Redwood should own the SCIM mapping + network coordination?

Thanks,
Samir
Infrastructure Program Manager
Elara Health

Attachment: Elara_Org_Policies.pdf (policy excerpts, 2 pages)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@elarahealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.example.com, monica_patel@redwood.example.com, ben_carter@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-03-08T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Access controls for Redwood rollout - initial ask

Hi Samir — great to hear. High level plan and owners below; I put proposed dates at the end.

Summary of what we need from Elara:
- IdP SAML metadata (XML) and a test IdP user for SP testing.
- SCIM: authoritative group attribute name for teams/orgunits and any custom attributes you must sync (e.g., site, cost_center).
- Network: list of firewall owners + any maintenance blackout windows (we'll provide exact CIDRs).

Redwood owners / asks:
- Priyom Das (CS integrations) — owns SCIM mapping and test provisioning flow.
- Monica Patel (Customer Success Eng) — owns SSO cutover sequencing and test coordination with your network team.
- Ben Carter (Security Eng) — will provide exact IP ranges and service account templates; will also validate least-privilege requirements.

Quick checklist we will follow for cutover:
1) Exchange SAML metadata and run SP tests (IdP test user)
2) Enable SCIM in dry-run mode for a staging group (validate attribute mapping)
3) Provision staging service accounts and run egress/ingress checks with whitelisted CIDRs
4) Canary: mid-week cutover for subset of users, monitor logs for 48 hours

Proposed tentative timeline:
- Metadata exchange + SP test: Week of Mar 15
- SCIM dry run: Mar 22
- Network whitelist validation: Mar 23-24
- Production cutover (2h maintenance window): weekend Mar 27-28 (target)

I'll attach our mutual action plan template and a short SSO/SAML checklist. If those work for you we'll lock dates and schedule the coordination calls.

Team — quick internal assignment after Vivek's reply. Keeping it tight so we can show momentum to Elara.

Actions: 
- Priyom: I'll draft the SCIM attribute mapping doc (include group/member rules, custom attrs) and share by EOD Mar 11. Deliverable: scim-mapping-elara.md + sample PATCH payloads.
- Ben: please generate the service account templates with minimal scopes and the RBAC mapping we require. Also confirm the CIDR list we'll ask Elara to whitelist (prod + staging).
- Monica: schedule a 30-minute network alignment call with Elara IT (include Nate or network lead). Target window: Mar 16 or Mar 17.

Notes: keep the SCIM dry-run limited to a single staging group ("elara-staging-team") so we can validate provisioning and deprovisioning behavior. Priyom, include a rollback checklist in the mapping doc.

Date: 2027-03-10T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Access controls for Redwood rollout - initial ask

Vivek / team — thanks, attached is our SP metadata and an excerpt of our org policy. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We prefer IdP-initiated flows for most users; we can do SP-initiated for admin consoles if needed.
- SCIM: we can expose group->members and the attributes for department and office_location. We do not expose cost_center via SCIM currently (that's only in HR system).
- IP allowlist: our network team requires a contact + an approval ticket; I'll open that once we have your CIDRs.
- Service accounts: we can create a scoped API account for staging and a separate one for prod; naming convention: svc-redwood-<env>.

Attached: Elara_SSO_Metadata.xml, Elara_Org_Policies.pdf

Questions: 
- For the SCIM dry-run, what exact attributes will Redwood write back (if any)? We want to avoid accidental overwrites.
- Can Redwood provide an automated rollback script for provisioning if something fails?

Thanks — I'm happy to join the network call next week.

—Samir
Infrastructure Program Manager
Elara Health

Samir — thanks for the metadata and the clarifications. Below is a short mutual action plan and next steps; I've attached the MAP with owners and dates.

Mutual Action Plan (summary):
- By Mar 15: Redwood to exchange SP metadata and provide test SP endpoints (owner: Vivek)
- By Mar 17: SCIM mapping doc + dry-run plan (owner: Priyom)
- Mar 23: Network whitelist validation (owner: Ben + Elara network)
- Mar 27-28: Production cutover (2-hour window) — canary rollout, monitor for 48h (owner: Monica)

Answers to your questions: 
- SCIM writes: Redwood will only create and update group membership and the attributes you expose (department, office_location). We will not write cost_center or HR-only attributes unless you explicitly request it in writing.
- Rollback: yes — Priyom will include an automated rollback script as part of the dry-run deliverables. It will perform deprovisioning of canary accounts and revert group membership changes created by the dry-run.

Network CIDRs (staging/prod) and contact for approval ticket:

- 34.213.57.0/25 (prod)
- Contact: ben_carter@redwood.example.com
